backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing poem and collection management with user profiles, notifications, and access control using Map-based storage for poems, collections, user profiles, and notifications with authorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five implemented features: optional Internet Identity login, in-app notifications for new poems, image poem downloads, text-to-image poem conversion downloads, and website title correction from 'Booli' to 'Boli'.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, utilities, and configuration files describing their functionality and purpose in the application.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes with warm earth tones and sidebar styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with corrected document title 'International Gojri Maa Boli Adab' and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, poem detail, admin form, and collection manager, wrapped in QueryClientProvider with UserProfileSetup modal.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with sticky header showing branding, navigation links (conditional on authentication), LoginButton, NotificationBell, main content outlet, and footer with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component handling Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/NotificationBell: Bell icon button with unread notification count badge that opens a popover containing the NotificationPanel component.
frontend/src/components/NotificationPane: Displays a scrollable list of notifications with loading states, empty states, and the ability to mark individual notifications as read using a check button.
frontend/src/components/PoemCard.tsx: Renders a clickable card for poems with two layouts: image poems show a cover image with overlay text, while text poems display title, author, date, and content preview with collection badges.
frontend/src/components/UserProfileSetup: Shows a modal dialog prompting authenticated users without a profile to enter their name, blocking interaction until profile setup is complete.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, initializing access control with an admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality, identity state management, and configurable AuthClient options for the application.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including poems, collections, search, user profiles, notifications, and admin functions with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global styles with warm earth-tone color schemes for light and dark modes using CSS custom properties, imports Google Fonts (Crimson Text, Lora, Inter), and applies Tailwind CSS.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the App component into the root DOM element.
frontend/src/pages/AdminForm.tsx: Admin form page for submitting new poems (text or image type) with authentication via Internet Identity, image upload with progress tracking, and success feedback.
frontend/src/pages/CollectionManager.tsx: Admin page for managing poem collections: create collections, add/remove poems to/from collections, delete collections, and view collection contents with authentication required.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Main landing page displaying all poems with search functionality, collection filtering, and debounced search that queries poems by title, content, author, or collection.
frontend/src/pages/PoemDetail.tsx: Individual poem detail page showing full poem content with download options: direct download for image poems or generated image download for text poems.
frontend/src/utils/downloadHelpers.ts: Utility functions for downloading images from URLs or Blobs and sanitizing filenames for safe file downloads.
frontend/src/utils/formatDate.ts: Utility function to convert Time (nanoseconds) to formatted date string in 'Month Day, Year' format.
frontend/src/utils/poemImageGenerator.ts: Canvas-based utility to generate decorative poem images with styled text, borders, gradients, and branding for text poems to be downloaded as PNG.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and methods to clear parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, custom fonts (Inter, Crimson Text, Lora), container queries, typography plugin, and accordion animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking for a Gojri poetry website with features including optional Internet Identity authentication, in-app notifications for logged-in users, and poetry download functionality (direct for images, text-to-image conversion for text poems).
